items.title: Wardogs 提供了《战地 6》中控制台大脑无法实现的功能：真正的服务器浏览器
items.summary: Millions of players, yet zero matchmaking.

content.v: Here's a neat thought: One of the most popular multiplayer games on the planet right now has no matchmaking button. FPS fans are flocking to Wardogs for its fresh ideas around teamwork, economy, and "all-out warfare." It's pulling in the largest crowds this sort of round-based, milsim-y FPS (a category that also includes Squad and Hell Let Loose) has ever seen.
It's very much filling the Battlefield-shaped hole in my game time, and that's in no small part due to its server browser.
Man, is it nice to press play on a main menu in 2026 and get options like this:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gZuqmdRMqZZ9sXBieF2sEF-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/K66JCVjbB4qojc9axeGmTF-1920-80.jpg

Check out that beaut: A complete list of official servers in my region, sortable by players, ping, rulesets, and maps. And would you look at that: A prominent community section featuring persistent servers rentable from third-party vendors.

No forced matchmaking. No skill-based algorithms. No disbanding lobbies (in community servers, at least). This is exactly the sort of convenient, community-forward setup that still appears regularly in niche milsims and indie shooters , and one that fans have been begging Battlefield to get back to.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/C5p5tomJDZufQ8C3ArB2hE-1920-80.jpg

It was around this time last year that EA was making a big to-do about Battlefield 6's community server support. Devs insisted that the Portal server browser, which doesn't support third-party server providers and instead allows players to spin up one semi-persistent lobby at a time, would "tick every box" for a proper server browser.

It did not: At launch, Portal servers were buggy, dominated by XP farming lobbies, and buried under a pile of Netflix menu tiles. As plenty of us predicted , interest in the Portal browser as an alternative to official matchmaking quickly died out, and now it's only good for goofy minigames and, somehow still, XP farming.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mkeAbeDvYbQoSWcvaoKG89-1920-80.jpg

When asked at the time why Battlefield 6 couldn't just have a real browser—the kind that lets you see all of the official servers as well as community-hosted ones—DICE lead producer David Sirland offered an answer that, in retrospect, is pretty weak sauce .

"Matchmaking servers spin up in seconds (get filled with players), and spin down after the game is over. That couple of seconds, plus when servers lose a lot of players, mid-game is the only time you can join, which makes it a tricky combination (and full of queuing to join issues)."

And yet, here we are: Wardogs has millions of players, and they seem to be navigating those "issues" just fine. Even the supposed drawbacks of manual browsing are barely a thing in Wardogs. There are currently so many official and community servers that finding one with a few spare slots takes seconds, and players cycle in and out of the 100-player matches so often that queues are rarely a long wait.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/auvueh9TdtXejQDGSBUMGX-1920-80.jpg

Meanwhile, the benefits are obvious: Community servers have admins that can punish cheaters and griefers faster than automated tools, and when they're allowed to flourish, these servers can be recognizable social spaces with regulars and customs. Developer Bulkhead isn't doing anything unique here, just what most PC shooters did 20 years ago.

The reality is that pulling off a server browser really comes down to will. Battlefield 6 doesn't have a real, prominent browser because EA doesn'tdon't want one. DICE built it like a console game (really, like Call of Duty) with algorithmic factors that get thrown off when folks can just hop into whatever server they want. So Portal was the compromise—a walled garden with restrictive, fake-persistent access to dedicated servers. It was a miscalculation about where the wind is blowing in the FPS scene, and it's still hurting an otherwise great game.

Wardogs' server browser is far from flawless. Basic features like favoriting and tiered queueing are still on the way, joining a server as a group is harder than it should be, and server admins are missing crucial tools—but it's a strong start for an early access game, and immediately more legitimate than Battlefield 6's sorry excuse for community support. In more ways than one, Battlefield could learn from Wardogs and smaller shooters like it.

items.title: 微软对 Xbox Game Pass 可能会大幅改变该服务的传言作出回应
items.summary: Microsoft has released a statement in response to a new rumor that claims the company is considering a massive

content.v: Microsoft has released a statement in response to a new rumor that claims the company is considering a massive shakeup to Xbox Game Pass in 2027 that would include numerous significant changes.

ResetEra user Slayven , who has accurately reported on unannounced Xbox news before , said the changes could include the bifurcation of Game Pass into two tiers: one with ads and one without. The tier with ads would be $13/month, while Game Pass without ads would cost $20/month, according to the report.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Xbox-2.png?w=636

That's $3/month less than Game Pass Ultimate currently, and the price cut is reportedly reflective of another big change: Microsoft is reportedly removing day-one new releases from Game Pass starting in the February-April window of 2027. The rumor also stated that cloud-streaming access is being taken out of Game Pass, but people can pay for a $6 add-on that gets you 25 hours. Additionally, the report said a Family Plan will be available for an extra $6/month.

Beyond all of this, the report claimed there will be a tier of Game Pass that costs $15/month, and for that, people will get access to select titles in the Game Pass library, along with online multiplayer. Finally, it was reported that Microsoft will also offer a $11/month membership that provides access to online multiplayer alone.
Microsoft responded to the rumor in a statement to GameSpot, originally obtained by Paul Tassi of Forbes .

The statement reads: "We regularly test different Game Pass offerings and look at what works best for players in different markets. We don’t have any changes to announce today or plans that have been finalized. There are no changes to previously announced games coming to Game Pass Ultimate on day one."
Not a random leaker

Reputable leaker NateTheHate said on ResetEra that Slayven has a track record for accuracy, at least somewhat, so "the individual giving them information clearly has knowledge of some matters." However, NateTheHate did not corroborate the reporting.

Slayven said on October 1, 2025 that Microsoft was raising the price of Game Pass Ultimate to $25--they were right about an increase, but it actually went up to $30/month . They were also right about the names changing from Game Pass Core to Game Pass Essential and Game Pass Standard to Game Pass Premium. They didn't get everything right, though, as Slayven said PC Game Pass was being removed, but it wasn't.
In any event, this latest rumor of a massive Game Pass shakeup should be taken with a grain of salt until Microsoft officially makes an announcement.
Game Pass has undergone big changes already

While it remains to be seen if this rumor proves accurate, Xbox's new CEO, Asha Sharma, has already made efforts to shake up Game Pass. One of her first moves after becoming CEO in February 2026 was to cut the price and remove new Call of Duty games from the service when they release. Sharma previously said Game Pass was too expensive and that she had big changes in store for it.
She also alluded to a longer-term vision after the price cuts. "Long term, we will evolve Game Pass into a more flexible system which will take time to test and learn around," she said.

That sounds like exactly what the rumor is suggesting. If the rumor is correct, or even parts of it, the new evolution of Game Pass would offer more options and possibly become cheaper for those who are OK with ads.

On the subject of ads, Microsoft just recently rolled out a test for an ad-supported version of cloud gaming , and it's not a stretch to imagine this could be expanded in new ways to help Game Pass reach more people by way of lower prices. Not everyone wants this , of course, and Microsoft is sure to face pushback just like other entertainment companies have for their own ad-based tiers of their own subscription services.

With regards to removing day-one releases, Microsoft is already doing this with Call of Duty, as this year's Modern Warfare 4 won't be available on the service at launch. Getting access to all of Microsoft's first-party games at launch as part of Game Pass was previously one of the membership's top selling points. New Call of Duty games will not come to Game Pass until the following holiday season, so people shouldn't expect Modern Warfare 4 until late next year.

Sharma has said she is considering a "range of options" for exclusives going forward, including "windowing" some games, and that could mean a lot of things for Game Pass and beyond. One possibility is that certain games are kept out of Game Pass at launch and for a period of time, similar to how movies are only available in theaters at first before coming to digital and streaming. The idea is that this pushes people to pay full price as opposed to getting access to new content as part of their membership right away.

So far, it's just Call of Duty that is being "windowed" in Game Pass. Minecraft Dungeons II will launch into Game Pass this month, as will Gears of War: E-Day in October. 2027's Fable will be a day-one release, too, in February 2027.

As for the cloud gaming changes, earlier this month, Microsoft announced that in November, the company will put limits on how many hours per month people can use the service. People can then pay more to unlock more time .

In addition to making Game Pass more affordable, Sharma might look to partner with Netflix on some kind of bundle offering for Game Pass. Netflix co-CEO Greg Peters said he and Sharma have “kicked around ideas” for how Netflix and Xbox could work together on subscription bundles. Nothing has been confirmed, but Peters said he “wouldn’t eliminate any possibilities.”
Speaking generally about Game Pass, Sharma has said one of her ambitions is to "fortify" the service with "clear differentiation and sustainable economics."

Sharma is also trying to get Xbox as a platform and company back into a healthy place, and that has meant drastic cuts of late involving layoffs, studio divestitures, and game cancellations. In regards to growth, Sharma recently oversaw the signing of Hideo Kojima for his new game, Physint , which was previously in the works at PlayStation. The game was reportedly over budget and late , which contributed to PlayStation's decision to part ways with Kojima.

items.title: 詹姆斯·庞德遗产的情况不仅仅是遇见人工智能
items.summary: Last month, System 3 Software released a trailer for James Pond Legacy, a four-game collection for Nintendo Sw

content.v: Last month, System 3 Software released a trailer for James Pond Legacy, a four-game collection for Nintendo Switch 2. But the gameplay footage was largely overshadowed by accusations its developer used generative AI to create the game's promotional artwork and cover. System 3 followed this trailer up with a blog post asserting that generative AI was not used in the development process for James Pond Legacy, but some wires were evidently crossed.

If you go back and watch that trailer, it's not difficult to see why viewers pointed out the AI-like quality of the 3D characters adorning the game's box art and other promotional material. When System 3 responded to the accusations with the assertion that "no generative AI was used in the creation of the artwork," referring specifically to the Bovine Bomber character, this was based on the information it was given at the time by Antstream, the studio that handled the collection's actual development.

"That was the statement that we were given at the time by Antstream," System 3 CEO Mark Cale told GameSpot during a call. "We weren't involved in the process. They supplied all of the artwork and they supplied, in the process, the [work-in-progress] illustration. All of that was given to us."
Cale later provided GameSpot with the statement it received back in December from Antstream, well before the trailer was made public.

"The art pipeline on some non-in-game assets includes algorithm-assisted depth and form translation: Original 2D concepts are input into a model to estimate volume and lighting, producing pseudo-3D drafts," reads the statement from Antstream. "Artists then manually repaint, re-render, and finalise all illustrations using this pipeline. The final assets are fully human-authored, with algorithms used only for intermediate visualisation."
You may notice that the statement omits the term "AI," which led to some internal confusion.

"We requested this [statement] for use across the board, including Steam, and to address applicable requirements under the EU Artificial Intelligence Act , including the transparency provisions that took effect on August 2, 2026," Cale explained. "Antstream now argues that, because we requested the statement for these purposes, we must have known the extent of their use of AI. However, their statement expressly describes the final assets as 'fully human-authored,' with algorithms used 'only for intermediate visualisation.'"
Had the use of generative AI been made clearer prior to the publication of the trailer and the blog post, System 3 would have taken a different approach, Cale said.

"That doesn't say 'generative AI,'" Cale said. "And if they've used any generative AI at all, it should have been clear in that statement. That was the statement we were told to put on to Nintendo, to Steam, PS5, Xbox--any format we want to go based on that. The actual gameplay itself is, of course, all emulated anyway. And for me, I don't know the definition of how you're going to try to say something that's prompt-based [is] 'generative AI' versus algorithms. And so we honestly looked at that and took that honestly to [mean] there was no AI."
GameSpot was unable to reach Antstream for comment during our time investigating the situation.

Cale said he is far from wanting to throw Antstream under the bus for what happened. He explained the reason Antstream was contracted for the project was because it had done "a bloody good job" of emulating games for past compilations, such as The Last Ninja Collection. The situation for James Pond was a little different, though, with little in the way of existing concept art or other production designs to go on for the in-game supplemental materials.

As someone wary, to put it mildly, of any generative AI usage in video games, I told Cale I would have preferred hand-drawn material created specifically for the collection based on past artwork, but Cale said it wasn't feasible.

"All of the artwork that has been created within the Pond-verse has been based on art that's either on the box cover or characters that are in the game," he said. "And at the end of the day, if people think we're going to redraw, re-render to that quality, and have 20 or 30 people working two years on it, forget it: It's not going to happen. We wouldn't put the Pond-verse in there. The simple fact is, it would not match an investment versus a return. I'm only speaking for myself--I can't speak for Antstream--but if it was for me, I wouldn't do it, because I couldn't justify having 20 artists for a year create all of that in that way."

Still, Cale said that full disclosure--and a clearer set of guidelines for what System 3 considers generative AI--should help to avoid another situation like this happening in the future. Having a set, and perhaps broader, definition for what constitutes generative AI will, at the very least, help prospective buyers know what they're purchasing.
It won't completely solve the problem, though, as Cale mentioned the need to be careful about using the term "AI" to describe any element in a game--even some that have existed for decades.

"AI's become such a swear word, and you should quote me on that!" Cale said. "So, you know, we're doing this other game. It's all been hand-done and everything, and I can't even say, 'Opponent AI's been tweaked to do this.' No, it's 'opponent behavior.' It's just madness! I just don't want to use the word 'AI' in anything, as far as I'm concerned, anymore."
James Pond Legacy: The Pond is Not Enough doesn't have a final release date yet, but will launch exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 at the end of October.

items.title: 《暗黑破坏神 4》玩家在新的复古赛季中发现了秘密的《暗黑破坏神 2》复活节彩蛋，现在每个人都想知道暴雪还藏着什么
items.summary: It's more than old bosses coming back for the Season of Hell's Legacy.

content.v: While server issues stalled the start of Diablo 4's new season for many players, a few were able to get in and discover something Blizzard carefully left out from official materials.

The focus for Diablo 4's Season of Hell's Legacy is celebrating the series' 30th anniversary. Blizzard went back to Diablo 2 and brought back Deckard Cain (in a dream) and three of its most iconic bosses: Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto. Each of them have updated versions of their old models and attacks, too.

Blizzard didn't indicate that it would be doing more than just a nostalgic storyline for season 15—but it is. Diablo 4 streamer Dioxide was able to squeeze past the login issues and found a number of new Runes available. Normally, these slot into your gear and give you passive bonuses, but Dioxide discovered there's more to them than that.

When he dropped two specific runes and a low-quality chestpiece into Diablo 4's crafting table, the Horadric Cube, it showed "???" as the recipe instead of one of the many listed on the side of the interface. When he clicked the transmute button, out popped the Stealth chestpiece, a Unique item from Diablo 2.

It turns out Blizzard added some of the Rune word item recipes from Diablo 2 without telling anyone. The Stealth armor is created exactly as people did more than two decades ago. It has different stats than the original, but carries the same relative power in Diablo 4 because it has two more stats than a normal Unique.

Now everyone is eager to see what other recipes are available and what other things Blizzard has hidden in the new season. The recent trailer has a pretty obvious hint for Diablo 3's rainbow-colored Whimsyshire level near the end with a creepy teddy bear: It isn't clear how to access it, but I'm sure someone will figure it out before the end of the day.

Ever since the release of the Lord of Hatred expansion for Diablo 4, Blizzard has been intentionally leaving stuff for players to find on their own. Nobody knew they would actually add the cow level , for example. I think it's a great approach when so many previous seasons felt kind of solved before they even began, and it maintains some of the mystery that the older games always had.

items.title: The Last Of Us Season 3 Is Probably The Final Season, HBO Says Yet Again
items.summary: HBO boss Casey Bloys has once again said that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us is expected to be it

content.v: HBO boss Casey Bloys has once again said that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us is expected to be its last.

He told Deadline that Season 3 is coming in 2027, though did not confirm when in the year. Asked if he still think it's the final season, Bloys said he believes showrunner Craig Mazin "has planned it as the final season."

In January this year, Bloys was asked if Season 3 is going to be the last, and he said, "It certainly seems that way." However, at the time, Bloys admitted that a decision like that would come down to Mazin.
Before this, Mazin said that Season 4 was essential to bring the show to a conclusion. However, Bloys has indicated that the show may wrap up its run with Season 3 , which could be a longer season.
“Craig is still working it out whether it will be two more seasons or one more long season. It hasn’t been decided yet, and I’m following Craig’s lead on that,” Bloys said in 2025.

In a big shift for the series, franchise creator Naughty Dog is not involved creatively in Season 3 , and Neil Druckmann dropped out as a writer/director. People have speculated about what this could mean, but Druckmann, for his part, said he left the show to focus on his work on Naughty Dog's games.
He is currently directing Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , and if it's true that Naughty Dog is also making The Last of Us 3 , he's probably involved in that, too.

items.title: 我是马克·扎克伯格
items.summary: What more do I have to say?

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Let's skip the preamble: I am Mark Zuckerberg now. The original Mark Zuckerberg? Who cares? He's knocked out in a ditch somewhere. Whatever. He's the past; I am the future. Specifically, the future of Mark Zuckerberg, who I am.

The latest mod I have installed into my increasingly uncontrollable build of Grand Theft Auto 5 is LifeInvader Business Mod , which grants you the ability to buy Rockstar's thinly veiled (which is to say, not veiled at all) parody of Facebook for the cool sum of a million bucks. I did not actually have a million bucks, but one of the 46,000 other mods I have installed let me grant myself that amount at the office's front door. In real life, this is called quantitative easing .

The mod is actually quite robust. It's not just a matter of buying the website and letting passive income roll in. You get a whole new menu through which you can staff up—acquiring devs of varying levels of talent—expand your server capacity, and even hire security to keep the hoi polloi away. You can donate to charity to buff your business' reputation, and have to keep an eye on staff morale.

Staff morale, by the way, is largely unimpacted by the flying car which has careened through the second floor window and begun gyrating around the server racks, gathering a pursuing swarm of monitors and wastepaper baskets behind it like a Saab pied piper. Nor do they mind, particularly, when armed men burst in and try to shoot their CEO, and they are equally unfazed when that CEO uses his laser vision to turn those men to hot slag.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HkNgPwMqEx9WAqYS9tHx6Z-1920-80.gif

Actually, while all this was ongoing, the mod kept serving me notifications: staff morale was at a steady 100% because the boss had showed up in the office, which is both appreciated and also not my experience of what happens when the boss shows up in the office. But Facebo—sorry, LifeInvader's developers are made of a different, hardier stock. It's a privilege to own them.

items.title: 《异形：火力小队 2》的 Nintendo Switch 2 版本推迟至 2027 年初
items.summary: Cold Iron Studios, developer of the recently released four-player co-op PvE sequel Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/15/afe2-1789490882491.jpg

Cold Iron Studios, developer of the recently released four-player co-op PvE sequel Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, has announced that the Nintendo Switch 2 version has been pushed back to early 2027. It was originally planned to ship this month.

"After careful consideration, we now plan to release it natively on Switch 2 in early 2027," the studio said in a statement. "This extra time will help the team deliver the best possible version for the hardware. Thank you for your patience and understanding. In the meantime, the team at Cold Iron remains aggressively focused on tuning Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 to be the best possible experience for every player."

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 is the second major third-party game today that's pushed back its planned Nintendo Switch 2 version. IO Interactive also announced that 007: First Light won't see the light of day on Nintendo's newest hardware until early next year.

IGN gave the PC, Xbox, and PlayStation version of Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 a 7 out of 10 , saying in part, "Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 isn’t going to make you leave a co-op shooter you already love at the altar, but it is a good time with friends."

content.v: 《巫师 3》是一款完美的电子游戏。这是双曲线吗？也许有一点。但毫无疑问，它是有史以来最伟大的角色扮演游戏之一，这款游戏获得了 92% 的评论分数，并且通过多年的修复、升级和扩展而变得更好，最后一个游戏为杰洛特史诗提供了一个完美令人满意的结局（甚至更高的评论分数）。

前 PC Gamer 编辑 Tom Senior 在对这一精彩结局的评论中承诺：“如果每年都有这样的扩展包推出，我到 2020 年仍然会玩《巫师 3》。”那么，这对汤姆来说是个好消息，因为令人惊讶的第三个扩展包《过去之歌》即将于 2027 年推出，而基础游戏的完整重制版和前两个扩展包将在此之前发布——事实上是在本月晚些时候。 CD Projekt Red 对重制版抱有远大的抱负，目标不仅是让它看起来和运行得更好，而且感觉也更好——就像一款新游戏，而不是 2015 年发布的新游戏。
这是一项艰巨的任务，同时也引发了一个问题：考虑到《巫师 3》所受到的尊重，是否有人担心会搞砸它？ CD Projekt 的旁白副总裁 Marcin Blacha 曾担任《巫师 3》的首席编剧和两部资料片的故事总监，对于他来说，答案很简单：“不”。
“对我来说，《巫师 3》不是一座纪念碑，也不是不可触碰的，”布拉查在最近的一次采访中告诉我们。 “它在我的记忆中仍然历历在目，它仍然不是一个参考点，但仍然是可以改进的东西。当我玩《巫师3》时，我仍然发现一些我认为也许现在我会做不同的地方。
“所以，你知道，添加一个新的扩展包并不是什么大事。事实上，当我们发现我们仍然拥有它时，你知道，我们拥有这个东西，我们仍然能够创造一个不仅适合原版《巫师 3》，也适合《石之心》和《血与酒》的故事，这仍然是一种非常令人振奋的感觉——一台时光机器让我回到了 10 年前，那时我还更年轻，也许更热情、更热情。”
Blacha 会做哪些不同的事情呢？ “也许有些事情我会做得更细致，”他继续说道，比如调整蒲公英，让他变得更明智、更支持他，而不仅仅是喜剧，或者在杰洛特与周围世界打交道时添加更多选择和后果。
但布拉查也承认，一些变化并不是由游戏中的任何问题或缺点引起的，而仅仅是因为——就像杰洛特一样——这些年来他发生了变化。
“当我从不同的角度看待某些事情时，这也可能是我衰老的过程。也许问题不在于游戏，而在于我，用不同的眼光看待游戏。”布拉查说。但这并不意味着《过去之歌》将成为电子游戏，就像一个脾气暴躁的老人坐在门廊上对孩子们大喊大叫。
“我们的团队既有《巫师 3》的资深人士，也有最近加入《愚人理论》或该项目的开发人员，”Blacha 说。 “所以我希望这不是一个老年扩张。总体而言，愚人理论的作家、任务设计师和开发者的热情将极大地推动它。”
《巫师 3》重制版更新将于 9 月 29 日推出，所有拥有基础游戏的人都可以免费使用。

content.v: 由 SIE 发行，曾制作《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列的 Insomniac Games 开发的 PS5 游戏《漫威金刚狼》预计将于 2026 年 9 月 15 日正式发售。顾名思义，这就是一款以在一众漫威超级英雄中拥有极高人气的金刚狼作为主角的动作冒险游戏。
本次《Fami 通》编辑有幸从 SIE 处提前拿到了《漫威金刚狼》的评测码。作为一名死忠漫威粉丝，笔者赶在游戏发售前爆肝通关了本作，并撰写了这篇评测为大家深入介绍游戏的玩法和内容。虽然文中不会包含破坏游玩体验的核心剧透，但如果你只想简单了解主角和登场角色的设定，或者大致熟悉一下系统框架的话，可能更适合看一看我们之前发布的前瞻内容和视频。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/9a0f5a6ea287e8a483a946e0a87bedd3/
暴力表现虽然是游戏的核心魅力，但并非主菜
在开始介绍本作之前，必须得先声明几个大前提。首先是本作的评级为CERO Z（仅限 18 岁以上），会包含大量血腥暴力表现。比起年龄限制 15+ 的《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列，本作明显更加成人向。其主要原因就在于血腥程度的差异，毕竟金刚狼是一个需要凭借自己引以为傲的利爪撕裂敌人的近战英雄，只要进入战斗，流血和断肢就是家常便饭。
但玩上一段时间之后，你就会发现“血腥暴力表现并非是本作的主菜”，其存在感并没有大家想象得那么突出。
不仅如此，玩家还可以在无障碍设置中自行调节血腥表现的程度，因此受不了血浆乱飞的玩家也大可放心。关闭暴力表现的选项后，就不会看到任何流血画面，断肢场景也会被打上马赛克。顺带一提，本作还在无障碍设置中引入了一整套完备的防 3D 眩晕措施，因为晕 3D 所以对动作游戏敬而远之的玩家也能够顺利游玩。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/4c0e9e509b00ef439158179e4ab57874/
重新发掘线性游戏的魅力
相较于以纽约街头为舞台的开放世界游戏《漫威蜘蛛侠》，本作的探索自由度明显下降了不少。直白地来说，《漫威金刚狼》甚至可以算是一款不折不扣的线性游戏。但如果你要问我是否会因此感到不满，那绝对不会，而且玩起来还相当有趣，上手之后根本停不下来。
最大的原因，就在于本作的剧情展开几乎没有任何尿点。虽然每次大幅推进剧情都会出现类似副标题的章节名称，但本作并没有采用传统的章节式结构，也几乎不会出现选择任务的画面（不能说完全没有，但非常少见）。只要不主动调出系统菜单，故事就会一刻不断地持续推进。到了可亲自操作的探索环节，玩家便能亲自操控金刚狼，遇到敌人的话便会直接开战。整体的游玩体验仿佛就是观看一部超级英雄电影。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/5ba43777f53e7f49eec525f15fabcd59/

当然，这么做的核心原因还是开放世界设计并不适合塑造金刚狼这名角色。但正因为舍弃了《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列的超高自由度，反而让人不知道什么时候才该回到现实世界中喘息片刻。一本道式的线性设计让玩家根本没有余地去思考接下来要干什么，可以长时间沉浸在这个世界当中。退一万步说，即便你在战斗中不幸被打倒，也会在不到 3 秒之后立刻在前一个检查点复活重生，根本没有空去想“要不要先休息一会？”，等回过神来，自己已经操纵着复活后的金刚狼再次踏上旅途了。游戏在流程推进的机制上设计得相当巧妙，甚至让我有一种被开发团队摆了一道的感觉。
战斗系统中的伟大发明
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/ce05a83af3d8b76b94f449c150662698/
游戏最核心的战斗系统也被打磨得十分出色，难度恰到好处。虽然有一定的挑战性，但又没到难如登天的地步，平衡性拿捏得很棒。不过在开始详细介绍战斗系统之前，我必须先为大家道个歉。在先前的前瞻文章当中，笔者一度以为弹反在本作中或许不那么重要，因为当时我只体验了约 2 个小时的游戏流程。事实证明，我的判断完全错了，通过深入游玩可以明确感受到弹反机制在本作中的核心地位。
弹反敌人的攻击时会伴随着“叮”的一声和华丽的视觉特效，被成功弹反的敌人会产生硬直，此时是玩家趁虚而入发动攻击的绝佳时机。
举个例子，假设你正在疯狂输出，然后突然看到敌人做出攻击前摇的动作，这时立刻按下弹反键，就可以强行打断当前的攻击动作触发弹反。所以你完全不需要担心“周围敌人随时可能发起攻击，所以是不是要少按几次攻击键留出弹反的窗口”。玩家要做的就是肆无忌惮地持续进攻，等到敌人的攻击动作出现再做出反应即可。最终产生的结果，就是游戏既没有削减痛殴敌人的爽快感，又成功凸显了弹反成功时的快感。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/08bc08682467b3d8dcf2797918e7a383/

游戏中的部分 Boss 战甚至会让人觉得完全就是围绕弹反机制来设计的。在与这类对手交战时，即便不幸落败，你也不会觉得是敌人太强，而是懊悔自己没掌握好弹反的时机，从而产生“再挑战一次！”的念头。只要熟悉了对手的动作，取得战斗胜利并不会太困难。正因如此，我强烈建议各位在第一次游玩时千万别查攻略，请务必在失利之后自行去思考“究竟该如何应对？”。因为在我看来，开发者在设定游戏难度的时候，已经把这个重复试错的过程也考虑在内了。
而本作在战斗系统方面最伟大的发明，当属围绕金刚狼自身的自愈因子设计而成的“背水一战”机制。简单来说，就是通过打倒敌人或成功执行某些动作后即可积攒“怒气槽”，攒够一定量之后，即便体力耗尽，玩家也能满血复活。在该系统的加持之下，在自身体力危急时，玩家又多了一个疯狂进攻积攒怒气的选项。不得不说，这种狂战士的战斗风格与金刚狼这名角色的特点完美契合，简直堪称神来之笔。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/c866b4a83a7920fffbbc0f484d084b72/
就我个人的体验而言，本作将怒气值与自愈因子相结合的设定可能还是达不到《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列把蛛丝摆荡的爽快感做到极致的划时代程度。但毫无疑问的是，这两部作品都是在对漫威超级英雄进行深入剖析之后，想方设法将其融入到游戏机制中的伟大尝试。游戏最终呈现出的质量也相当之高，只要是喜爱《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列的玩家，绝对也能在本作中玩个爽（虽然受限于角色本身的性格设定，搞笑滑稽的元素明显更少了）。
真正的“可交互式电影”
由于笔者对漫威旗下的作品有一定的了解，所以本作刚开始最让我感到意外的地方，反而是经常作为反派登场的剑齿虎和魔形女这次居然是金刚狼的同伴。虽然琴·葛蕾也有在游戏内登场，但粉丝们再熟悉不过的镭射眼、暴风女等同伴却都没露面（老实说有点遗憾）。尽管并非是我们在影视作品里常常见到的《X 战警》队伍配置，但多元宇宙的设定对于由美漫改编而成的作品来说也算是见怪不怪了，甚至会让人觉得“这才对味！”。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/2e71a37287d7aa33cfaa8ea71f843772/
当然，即便你完全不了解漫威相关的作品，也能充分享受本作的乐趣。在推进故事的过程中，就连对金刚狼有所了解的笔者都一直抱着“这究竟是什么样的一个世界观啊？”的疑问，直到剧情进一步展开后才终于搞清楚是怎么一回事。因此，即便是刚刚接触漫威宇宙的玩家也不会出现体验大打折扣的情况。

如果你是第一次接触漫威作品的玩家，我想告诫大家一点。要是抱着“反正是基于漫画改编，不用想都是金刚狼出场打败邪恶反派，最终惩恶扬善的爽文剧情吧？”的期待来游玩的话，可能会感到些许的落差。虽然没有深入进行探讨，但在这个存在变种人的世界之中，游戏还是会对少数群体的苦恼等与现代社会紧密相连的严肃内容进行一定的展现。从某种意义上来说，这也算是本作“成人向”的一面。话虽如此，不仅仅是本作，几乎所有的漫威作品或多或少也都带有这个特征。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/96c08e3cfc2b6f8840fa92d72224139c/
综上所述，本作在电影感的呈现上绝对是无与伦比的。无论是令人惊呼“居然是这样吗？”的剧情转折，张弛有度的节奏把控和伏笔回收，还是动作场景的镜头调度都非常有好莱坞电影的感觉，十分对我的胃口。
尽管没有明说，但部分场景不禁会令人怀疑是不是在致敬某部电影。如果你是资深电影迷的话，说不定能看出更多门道
虽然还有很多可以介绍的内容，但在游戏发售前最好还是不要透露太多细节，我也就点到为止了。总之，从一个漫威粉丝的角度出发，我真的很感谢 Insomniac Games 开发团队能够基于金刚狼的原创故事打造出这么一款优秀的游戏作品。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/8c1c787add7ae96e6153cb9fe5c0815b/
不过，也正是因为游戏足够有趣，我才更加希望能在本作中看到更多其他的《X 战警》英雄或反派。尽管在游戏发售前说这种话可能有点得了便宜还卖乖，但我甚至已经开始遐想“既然已经设计出了这套系统，那同样拥有自愈因子的死侍是不是也能单独出一款游戏了？”。由此也可以看出我个人对本作的制作水准没有任何的不满，全程玩得都很享受，希望我能够把自己的这种感受成功传递给大家。
原作者：斋藤モゲ 翻译：弹丸 编辑：熊猫命

items.title: 每款《女神异闻录》游戏和衍生作品均按顺序排列
items.summary: A complete timeline of Shin Megami Tensei's most beloved spin-off.

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2021/02/12/persona5strikers-blogroll-1613157755666_160w.jpg

Beginning its life as a Shin Megami Tensei spin-off, the Persona series has become one of the biggest names in modern RPGs. From multiple major sequels and remakes to anime adaptations and even stage plays, Persona is a multimedia sensation, and its popularity doesn’t seem to be slowing down anytime soon.

With the official announcement of both Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 , new players are probably wondering where’s the best place to start. Below, we’ll give you a full rundown of every game and spin-off, including the best entry point for newcomers and both the chronological and release order of the series.
Jump to :
How Many Persona Games Are There?

In total, there are currently 21 Persona games . Several of these are expanded versions of the mainline entries in the series, whether that’s in the form of re-releases featuring new story content or remakes. While we won’t include direct ports or remasters, we’ll make sure to note every alternate version of each game when listing them below.
Every Persona Game and Spin-Off in Release Order
Which Persona Game Should You Play First?

If you're looking for the perfect place to start, you can’t really go wrong jumping into Persona 3 Reload or Persona 5 Royal. They’re the latest versions of the third and fifth mainline entries in the series, and are available on PC and every major console.

For those concerned about skipping the story by jumping into later entries in the series, you won’t miss anything by going straight to Persona 3, 4, or 5. Each game tells an entirely new story with original characters that’s largely disconnected from its predecessors, so they’re great launching points for those coming in fresh. To narrow your choices down, I'd recommend taking a look at some gameplay videos, social links, and even the soundtracks across each game to see what "stands out" to you.
Every Persona Game and Spin-Off in Chronological Order
These blurbs contain mild spoilers for each game, including characters, settings, and story beats.
1. Revelations: Persona (1996)
https://assets.ign.com/thumbs/2009/07/09/personapsp_randombattle-41.jpg

The first game in the series, Revelations: Persona was Atlus’ reaction to the positive reception of Shin Megami Tensei: If… , which was another Shin Megami Tensei spin-off centered around high-schoolers battling demons. Capitalizing on how much players enjoyed the central concept, Revelations: Persona offered a full dungeon-crawling RPG centered around a group of high schoolers battling a supernatural uprising throughout the town of Mikage-cho.

Along the way, they use the powers of their awakened Personas to take down shadows and explore dungeons filled with random encounters, leveling up their party and growing stronger over the course of the game. Revelations: Persona was the foundation of the franchise as we know it today, introducing elements like wielding Personas in combat, the Velvet Room and a teenage cast of heroes.
2. Persona 2: Innocent Sin (1999)
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2010/11/12/persona-2-innocent-sin-20101112113022571-3351586.jpg

The second entry in the Persona series, Persona 2: Innocent Sin launched in 1999. The game follows a new set of high-school students led by protagonist Tatsuya Suou, who set out on a mission to take down a mysterious villain known as Joker and the cult of the Masked Circle.

Centring around an evil plot where malicious rumors spreading around the town of Sumaru come to life, Persona 2 once again focuses on exploring dungeons, wielding Personas, fighting shadows and leveling up your party. Unlike other entries in the series, it received a direct sequel just a year later, with Persona 2: Eternal Punishment acting as a continuation of the game's story.
Read our review of Persona 2: Innocent Sin .
3. Persona 2: Eternal Punishment (2000)
https://assets2.ignimgs.com/2000/12/05/persona_92-197773.jpg

Following up the events of Innocent Sin, Eternal Punishment promoted side character, Maya Amano, to the protagonist role. Sent to write an article about a new rumor regarding a phenomenon known as the Joker Curse, the game quickly sees Maya and her allies rally against a returning foe.

Acting as a direct continuation of Innocent Sin's story, it centers on the same style of turn-based, dungeon-crawling gameplay, as players build their party and wield their Personas to battle shadows.
Read our review of Persona 2: Eternal Punishment .
4. Persona 3 (2006) / Persona 3 FES (2007) / Persona 3 Portable (2009) / Persona 3 Reload (2024)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/01/30/persona3reloadalt2-review-blogroll-1706584896935.jpg

The third mainline entry in the franchise, Persona 3 was a major evolution of the Persona formula. Opting to focus on its high-school premise, Persona 3 introduced a daily calendar , with one half of the game tasking players with attending school, developing friendships and studying, while the other sent them to fight shadows in the supernatural realm of Tartarus.

The story focuses on high school student Makoto Yuki, who finds he's able to experience a mysterious space of time known as the Dark Hour, where regular people are trapped in coffins and a demonic tower sprouts from his school. Teaming with his classmates, he explores the tower, uncovering a sinister plot that threatens the entire world. Persona 3 is considered a landmark entry for the series, introducing social links, day-to-day activities and many other mechanics that have since become synonymous with the franchise.
Read our review of Persona 3 Reload .
Alternate Versions of Persona 3:

There are multiple ways to play Persona 3, with the game being re-released three times since it launched. Persona 3 FES was an expansion of the game, including its follow-up chapter, The Answer, and an alternate campaign with a female main character. Persona 3 Portable was a handheld version of the game, which includes the female main character route but not The Answer. And Persona 3 Reload is a full remake of the base game for modern consoles, although it doesn’t include The Answer or the female main character route.
5. Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight (2018)
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2018/06/07/p3d-2-1528409704555.png

A rhythm-based dancing spin-off of Persona 3 that takes place during the main campaign, Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight sees Elizabeth challenge the S.E.E.S team to a dance-off in the Velvet Room. The events of the game are set during a dream but are completely canon to the story, and follow the team performing various dance routines to iconic Persona 3 tracks.
6. Persona 4 (2008) / Persona 4 Golden (2012)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/04/09/personathumb-1681062251031.jpg

The fourth mainline entry in the Persona series, Persona 4 takes place in the rural town of Inaba. Players assume the role of Yu Narukami: a high schooler from the city who moves to the country to live with his uncle and cousin for a year. After arriving, a string of violent murders begin to take place in the town, as Yu and his friends quickly discover they’re somehow linked to a mysterious otherworldly realm they can access by stepping through TV monitors.

Delving into this mysterious new world, Yu and his friends face supernatural forces as they learn more about the murders, using their powers to try and stop them. Building off the mechanics of Persona 3, Persona 4 once again utilizes the calendar system, as players build social links and attend school while also exploring vast dungeons and defeating enemies with their Personas.

items.title: 如果你需要证明《巫师 3》的新资料片是安全的，其首席作者在《石之心》中写下了她的论文：“可能是为了向我的一些教授证明游戏是有价值的”
items.summary: 任务完成了。
items.titleEn: If you need proof The Witcher 3's new expansion is in safe hands, its lead writer literally wrote her thesis on Hearts of Stone: 'To probably prove to some of my professors that games are worthy'

content.v: 如果你需要证据证明《巫师 3》即将推出的资料片《往日之歌》背后的团队是由真正的巫师 Sickos 组成的，请尝试这样做：该资料片的首席作者在大约十年前就写下了她关于《石之心》的学士论文。
Fool's Theory 的 Paula Mejsner 在 2017 年的论文中对《巫师 3》的第一个资料片进行了比较文学手术——早在她开始研究游戏本身之前——题为（英文）“电子游戏作为体验文学的一种方式：对‘巫师 3：狂猎’的 DLC‘石之心’的分析”。
当我坐下来和她谈论她在《过去之歌》中的工作时，我不得不做一件我永远不会原谅别人对我做的事情：我问她这件事。
“当时我正在玩《石之心》和《巫师》，当时我正在学习比较文学。就在那时，我爱上了《巫师》……[这篇论文]触及了我所说的《巫师》的文学参考文献有多么丰富。”
具体来说，梅斯纳写了《巫师》如何传达波兰经典文学的精神，“就像维斯皮安斯基的《婚礼》和冈特·奥迪姆的整个角色一样，这个邪恶的角色也基于许多其他文化。
“我想对其进行分析，我这样做可能是为了向我的一些教授证明游戏是有价值的，而且它们也是文化的文本。”
至于 2017 年的 Mejsner 对于真正开始编写资料片会有什么感觉？她会非常兴奋的。 “说实话，我对自己感到非常自豪，我确实能够[为《巫师》工作]。但是，你知道，一如既往，这个过程中有很多运气。但是，是的，这确实是梦想成真，因为这就是我在写论文时的梦想。写杰洛特真是太棒了。”

items.title: 不，AI，你不是人类：微软的人工智能实践守则实际上给了我这个行业一些希望
items.summary: 也许这是一个傻瓜的希望。
items.titleEn: No, AI, you are not human: Microsoft's code of practice for artificial intelligence actually gives me some hope for the industry

content.v: 不管你相信与否，我实际上并不喜欢对人工智能这样的新技术感到悲观和沮丧——这只是世界不断给我的东西。因此，如果我不花时间来报道一些真正积极的事情，我会被诅咒的，而且我对微软新发布的人工智能培训和操作行为准则持犹豫乐观的态度，就是这样一个机会。
总体目标与微软之前宣称的一样：“人文主义超级智能（HSI）”。但现在，它的含义得到了更多的扩展。尽管该公司指出当前的代码仍在开发中，并且正在敞开大门征求反馈。
在解释行为准则的摘要列表中，Microsoft 列出了十项准则：
所有这一切对我来说似乎都很棒，而且有些事情我特别高兴看到。具体来说，第二点：“福利模式的想法是错误的。人工智能不应该拥有权利或法人资格。”
这不是纸上谈兵的哲学：确实有人（可能有影响力的人）认为人工智能应该被赋予道德权利等等。这是危险的，因为如果我们开始赋予人工智能权利，那么我们可能会将它们与我们置于平等的地位，并可能开始认为我们必须为“它们”做一些对我们不利的事情。例如，尽管对真正有意识的人有任何负面影响，但仍保持整个人工智能行业的发展。
说到这里，微软还表示，AI“不是有意识的，也不应该被设计来模仿意识”。宾果游戏。我完全同意。
我对当今通常定义和实践的“人文主义”有一些疑虑，因为除了以人为本的基本观点之外，它还经常与多余和误导的学说并存，例如科学主义。不过，在这里，微软似乎至少在简单意义上指的是人文主义，即确保人工智能的设计以人为本，将人类的控制、价值观、目标和安全放在首位。
然而，我注意到的一个潜在的混乱原因涉及对“多元价值观”的关注：
“人类最大的优势在于其文化、思想和价值观的多样性和多样性。我们认为人工智能应该支持广泛的经验、世界观和信仰。人文主义人工智能的构建是为了涵盖传统、背景和繁荣形式的多样性。多元主义并不意味着对伤害保持中立或任何事情都会发生。人文主义植根于广泛、包容的人类价值观，例如人类尊严、安全、自主和基本人权。”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pgEyxVwFgWDjXZC987kqUN-1920-80.png
听起来不错，对吧？但作为一个有哲学背景的人，了解在花时间彻底质疑伦理时可能发生的各种辩论——甚至在人工智能伦理委员会等董事会中也可能发生的辩论——我认为我们需要意识到这会带来什么样的原则性问题。
目前尚不清楚是否有可能既包含多种价值观又同时防范伤害。微软明确表示，它正在谈论“广泛、包容的人类价值观”，例如基本人权，但在价值观发生冲突的特定情况下，当橡胶遇到道路时该怎么办呢？
这里可能不是讨论具体的和可能有争议的例子的地方，现在也不是时间，但重点是我们总是从特定的角度评估事物，因此总是会拒绝竞争的价值观。试图在防止伤害和拒绝道德相对主义的同时解释不同的价值观是一个崇高的目标，但这在实践中到底意味着什么——什么构成伤害以及哪些价值观是允许的——将正是问题所在。
我想在本实践代码的其余部分中，我们至少现在对这些特定值标志的植入位置有了一些了解。当然，假设并不只是说说而已。

items.title: 世嘉正在努力重振《疯狂出租车》，现在似乎正在采取……电影的形式？
items.summary: 是的，我也不知道。
items.titleEn: Sega's ongoing effort to revive Crazy Taxi now appears to be taking the form of… a movie?

content.v: 《疯狂出租车》是一款关于速度的游戏——当乘客在你的车上花费的平均时间不到半分钟时，就没有时间了解任何传说了。我只需要知道你想去肯德基，而不是你为什么要去那里。
世嘉在某种程度上试图在其复兴《疯狂出租车：世界巡回赛》系列的尝试中注入一种叙事——根据我在科隆游戏展上进行的一小时的上手体验，我还没有完全相信这款游戏。我不知道你能从一个多次违反交通规则的家伙身上得到一个多好的故事——尽管话又说回来，你可能会说这是有史以来的每一部《速度与激情》电影——但Netflix清楚地看到了其中的一些滑稽之处，因为它是世嘉公司决定要改编的众多项目之一。
据 Variety 报道，《疯狂出租车》将采取喜剧电影的形式，由丹·格雷戈尔和道格·曼德（负责《裸枪》2025 年重启）编剧。在制作方面，它将由 Original Films 和 Toru Nakahara 负责——他们两人还制作了全部三部《刺猬索尼克》电影以及《纳克鲁斯》和《索尼克 Prime》电视节目。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/r4GjsvUzBBsm2mNenGoyXJ-1920-80.png
Original Film 的尼尔·H·莫里茨 (Neal H. Moritz) 和托比·阿舍尔 (Toby Ascher) 在一份声明中写道：“我们非常高兴能够继续与世嘉的长期合作关系，并与 Netflix 的合作伙伴一起将《疯狂出租车》变为现实。” “这部电影适合那些在 Dreamcast 上驾驶黄色出租车几个小时、伴随着音乐、冲破视野中的一切，只为了下一次旅程的人。”
现在我也是这些人中的一员，但说实话，我有点不确定如何让一个留着 90 年代高髻的人在路上 20 米处接人并把他们放下来，完成整整 90 分钟的动作。不过，电影确实用更少的资源创造了更多的素材，所以谁知道呢？
世嘉和 Netflix 的锦囊妙计还不止于此。它还正在制作另一部动画《索尼克》电视连续剧，以及改编成的电影《天堂陌生》。你知道，那场比赛还没有结束。
我觉得在过去的几年里，我们对真正优秀的视频游戏电影改编一直处于相对不错的热潮中，尽管我担心 Netflix 将任何东西变成直接流媒体欢闹的倾向可能会让我们很快又回到平庸的领域。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/02/25/re9-postgame-br-1772061133503.jpg
从今年早些时候令人兴奋的《安魂曲》上映到本周末扎克·克雷格的新电影上映，对于《生化危机》粉丝来说，这是一个激动人心的时刻。如果您还没有玩过前者，或者只是渴望进入其他一些游戏，百思买现在为粉丝们准备了更多优惠，藏在“每日优惠”部分。
PS5、Nintendo Switch 2 和 Xbox Series X 上的《生化危机安魂曲》在零售商处折扣至 45 美元，而《生化危机 4》、《生化危机 3》、《生化危机 2》和《生化危机 7》均降至 13 美元。然而，正如其销售页面标题所示，百思买的这些优惠仅在今天剩余时间内有效。因此，如果您已经关注其中一款（或多款）游戏，那么现在就是购买它们的最佳时机。

不过，利用这些交易的时间已经不多了。今天（而且仅限今天），您可以在“每日特惠”页面刷新之前在百思买 (Best Buy) 购买每件商品，以优惠价购买，所以趁它们仍在以如此优惠的价格打折时，赶快购买吧。
